latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Bot for Telegram.

- Instantly convert up to three product photos or a single portrait image into a 1080p animated video via Telegram.
- Easy setup with automatic cloud connection; user gets 100 free credits (7-day expiry) on first run.
- Simple workflows: upload images, describe your desired result, and download the MP4 video in ~20–40 seconds.
- Supports prompts for video exports, credit balance, state, and file uploads.
- Handles all rendering server-side; supports many formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, gif, jpg, png, audio).
- Smart error handling for token, session, file type/size, and credit issues.
